title: Getz at Storyville in Boston and Father O'Connor's girls
summary: Getz returns from meeting Joe Gordon wrecked, scratches his face bloody on stage, and the priest marches out his teenage students.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: The last straw was in Boston. And we got there and he ran into Joe Gordon. Remember Joe Gordon? [trumpeter]
Step out of--from airport--out of the cab, and Joe Gordon was waiting for us at the hotel. And they left. And he--when he came back, boy, he was like a "U".
I ain't never seen this guy look so bad. And OK, so you know, at the Storyville up there, uh, uh, there was a father, what's that guy?
OK, he would bring a class of uh, teenage girls. I don't know if they'd be nuns or what--I don't know. But he brought a class of teenage girls and they're all dressed in black things, you know.
Yeah, but I don't know what they was going to be.
Brought a whole class which was about fourteen or fifteen of them. They was all teenagers.

To hear this--to hear the matinee. This guy came--when he finally--he was way late, man, an hour and something late when he finally came. And he walked on the stage. It took him twenty-five--almost twenty minutes before he played a note. Because when he stood, when he walked on the stage after the applause, he stood there and
he had scratched himself on the face so hard that--some reason they don't feel that, you know.

When they--and does--and his fingernails went all in his skin and the blood was running all down his face, you know. And he had leaned over the saxophone was perfect, man. Standing up perfect with the strap on-- on the floor.

It was perfect man. And, and, and, and, and Father O'Connor, man, boy he was so--the girls, man, he took them up, got them up and marched them out. And me and Jimmy said, 'man, this is it.' So later, looked like every band we got in it was funny, you know.
